children: Godrej Properties' shares look attractive after a recent selloff, with the worst likely largely priced in, Nomura analyst Akash Gupta says in a note. Gupta expects the developer to keep growing presales steadily and generate free cash flow from FY 2028, moderating net debt growth. The shares are trading at a much smaller premium to net asset value than Nomura expects. Nomura upgrades the stock to buy from neutral and cuts its target price to 1,900 rupees from 2,100 rupees on higher cost of capital to reflect volatility. Shares are down 0.2% at 1,494.30 rupees. (venkat.pr@wsj.com)
